params.note: NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 (driver-level TF32 kill switch), 128-env config, discriminating test for the grasp regression (see REGRESSION_HANDOFF.md)

summary: TF32-off run reproduces the exact stuck signature at 106k episodes: test/grasp never crossed 0.5 (peak 0.14 at ep 33006, currently oscillating 0.0-0.08), the same flat failure seen in every post-07-20 run. This is the discriminating test from REGRESSION_HANDOFF.md, called well past its 4-6k verdict window, and the verdict is unambiguous: TF32 is exonerated as the cause.

findings.description: grasp flat in 0.0-0.14 band through 106k episodes; healthy runs (832c0e23, 2a717e4c) crossed 0.5 by ep 3-4k. Paper ON_TRACK window for grasp>=0.9 is 20-50k ep -- this run is 2x past that window and hasn't even reached 0.5.
findings.recommendation: TF32 is exonerated (this run had NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 and still failed identically). Proceed to next bisection step in REGRESSION_HANDOFF.md: git checkout 7001485 (pre-instrumentation commit, era of the healthy 07-17 image), rebuild, rerun same config+seed for ~5k episodes.

findings.description: alpha decayed from 0.0498 to 0.00199 -- consistent with the known stuck-run signature (alpha decay to ~0.001) but this also occurred in healthy runs, so not independently discriminating.
entropy currently 0.478, having earlier peaked near 1.5 (observed mid-run) -- matches the documented stuck-run signature (rises to ~1.5 then drifts down to a low plateau).
At 106k episodes grasp should be saturated per paper (ON_TRACK crossing 0.9 by 20-50k); instead it has never exceeded 0.14.
findings.recommendation: See policy_learning finding above -- this is the ongoing regression, not new information about paper fidelity.

comparison: Same stuck signature as prior post-07-20 runs (a9402350, 6418601d, 58cf3752) -- flat grasp <=0.16, no learning. This run isolates and rules out TF32 specifically since it disabled TF32 at the driver level and still failed.
paper_vs_run: Run is 2x past the paper's ON_TRACK window for grasp>=0.9 (20-50k ep) with grasp still near zero at 106k -- consistent with every other run since the 07-20 regression began, confirming this is not a TF32 issue.
